text:
sam: Quick sync  planning a microlaunch social flow for the inference tuning feature. Goal: drive webinar sign-ups + early trials. Need copy, assets, and inbound routing by Fri EOD.

rachel: Proposal: Day 0 AM X hook thread (3 tweets), Day 0 mid LinkedIn longform (10am PT), Day 0 PM deep-dive X thread with chart + CTA, Day 1 follow-up customer quote + reminder.

miguel: For headline metric we should pick one clear number. Options: "~30-35% lower cost per response" (practical) or "sub-40ms p95" (engineering). We'll A/B.

design: Asset ask: 1 hero GIF 16:9 (<4s), 2 static thumbnails (1200x675 & 1200x628), alt text, and a 1-slide caption card for LinkedIn. GIF storyboard Wed AM, first cut Thu.

ops-bot: HubSpot form + webhook created: https://hooks.example.com/hubspot/microlaunch-3467. Shortlink: https://go.redwood.ai/micro3467 (tracks utm_source=social, utm_campaign=microlaunch). Hidden fields: source=social, campaign_variant. Test payload as string: '{"email":"test+social@redwood.com","campaign_variant":"A","source":"social"}'.

miguel: Add a hidden field 'traffic_bucket' to split paid vs organic. We want to attribute signups precisely.

ops-bot: Added traffic_bucket. Scheduler set to America/Los_Angeles. Posts will be native X threads (no image-of-text) and include alt text per image.

paid-media: Recommend $750 day-of spend, split 60% AM / 40% PM. Targeting: infra engineers, platform PMs, ML engs in NA. Conversion = hubspot form submit.

rachel: Messaging iteration plan: roll Variant A (cost-first) to 40% impressions and Variant B (latency-first) to 60%. Monitor CTR + sign-ups at 2h intervals; if one outperforms by >20% switch allocation.

sam: Copy roughs (short):
- sam: "Cut inference cost ~35% for routine prompts. See the benchmark + demo: https://go.redwood.ai/micro3467 #RedwoodInference"
- sam: "Serve responses faster  sub-40ms p95 in our tests. RSVP for the webinar: https://go.redwood.ai/micro3467"

miguel: I'll QA the metric language vs the benchmark and sign off. No publishing until I approve the chart + methodology.

design: Reminder: provide each tweet as separate lines (native thread), include GIF frame captions and alt text file.

ops-bot: Scheduler will post in local timezone windows and attach UTM params. Confirmed shortlink redirects and captures campaign_variant.

sdr-bot: SDR routing: immediate Slack ping to #sdr-inbound on each new signup with name, company, and top engagement signal (clicked GIF / engaged thread). Daily CSV at 8:30am to sdr@redwood. Tag "high-engage" for anyone who clicked GIF + submitted form.

lex: I'll own the daily digest and triage flow. Prefer CSV + direct HubSpot link per lead. Also want top commenters exported for community follow-up.

paid-media: Also run a small LinkedIn boost ($300) for the longform, targeting senior PMs and platform leads. Conversion tracking to same form.

rachel: Final ops ask: include a shortlink param campaign_variant=A/B so we can tie A/B impressions back to signups.

ops-bot: shortlink updated to accept campaign_variant param. Example: https://go.redwood.ai/micro3467?campaign_variant=A

miguel: Good. I'll review the bench and post approval by Thu noon. If design misses the GIF deadline, we push launch 48h.

sam: Thanks everyone  creating a Notion checklist and tagging owners. Ping here when drafts land. :rocket:
